messages:
alex_sales: Aurora Systems just asked for a custom term: 20% off Dedicated for 6 months (they're committing to a 6-mo pilot) and Net60 on first invoice because their procurement missed the PO window. Can we approve a promotional contract amendment?
nina_finance: Need numbers. What's the estimated credit amount and revenue impact?
alex_sales: Their current monthly run-rate for the Dedicated pool is ~$40k. 20% off for 6 months ~= $48k total. They offered a signed amendment to lock plan and a 6-month commit. They want Net60 on the first invoice only.
jordan_revops: Big flag: credits >$10k require VP sign-off and comp ops review for commission implications. Also caps on promotional discounts in our pricing policy.
paul_legal: Contractually we can do a promotional amendment but it must be narrowly scoped: one-time promotional schedule with explicit term dates, non-precedential clause, and payment-term change limited to a single invoice. Also need to confirm commit language is enforceable (minimums, early termination charges).
helen_fpna: Finance rule: directors can approve up to $25k discretionary credits; anything above needs VP/CFO approval. $48k exceeds that. However, if the discount is structured as a time-limited list-price reduction tied to a signed 6-mo commit with minimum spend, we might recognize revenue differently. Need FP&A modeling.
nina_finance: Proposed compromise: approve a $25k one-time promotional credit (approved by FP&A) plus Net60 for first invoice only, contingent on a signed amendment that includes a 6-month minimum spend clause. If sales needs the full 20% across 6 months, escalate to VP Finance.
alex_sales: Aurora prefers the full 20% but will accept $25k + Net60-first-invoice to close quickly. I can ask them to accept commit language.
jordan_revops: I'll open comp ops ticket CO-4010 to capture commission adjustments for the $25k credit. If we later escalate, update the ticket.
paul_legal: Draft ack language: "Redwood Inference will apply a one-time promotional credit of $25,000 to invoice INV-2026-1103. Customer agrees this credit is non-recurring and that a signed amendment defining the 6-month committed usage and early termination remedies is required for the discount to apply. Payment terms for the first invoice are modified to Net60 only. This acknowledgement resolves the current billing request." Paste this in sales email.
billing-bot: Retrieved INV-2026-1103: Dedicated pool charges: 8 GPUs x 720h = $32,000; Support = $2,400; Tax = $1,152; Total = $35,552.
helen_fpna: Approve internally: $25,000 credit + Net60 on first invoice only, contingent on signed amendment and minimum spend language. VP Finance will review if Aurora pushes for full 20% across 6 months.
alex_sales: Sending to Aurora now. I'll push for the full discount but will try to get the signed amendment for the $25k today.
jordan_revops: CO-4010 created and linked to Deal Desk entry DDK-2026-201.
paul_legal: Please ensure the amendment includes: minimum monthly committed spend, term dates, and non-precedential wording.
billing-bot: Action queued: create CM-2026-121 for $25,000 pending customer_ack_aurora_2026-04-02.eml and signed amendment. Will apply credit on receipt.
nina_finance: Documented approval: $25k credit + Net60 x1. Add to Deal Desk and tag AR for DSO impact. Closing here once signed docs received.
alex_sales: Aurora accepted $25k + commit language. Signed amendment uploaded to Deal Desk. Thanks team :raised_hands:
